## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 412 captures during December 2025. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and represents the number of images submitted for review. The activity was completed at the clinic and formed the basis for the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

There were 25 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 6.1 per cent. These results indicate that a proportion of the images could not be assessed and should continue to be monitored through routine site operations. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead.

## Grading

Grading identified 112 referable results from the submitted captures. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This is the median time recorded between image capture and completion of grading for the reporting month. The clinic should continue to review grading performance alongside image quality and operational issues.
